collection.artStorage: fully on-chain SVG, generated by the factory's shared renderer
collection.artRegeneration: on every acquisition from the pool archive; never on a wallet-to-wallet transfer
collection.customDesigns: not supported in v1; launchers cannot supply artwork or renderer code
collection.reversePath: none; an NFT cannot be turned back into SHARD outside a sale

atomicOrder: validate actual hook creation bytes and exact permission bits
deploy NFT against the factory-shared renderer
bind hook and NFT in both directions
store and emit the configuration hash
launch.rendererScope: one renderer shared by every collection launched from a factory
launch.effectiveTokenSalt: keccak256(abi.encode(rawTokenSalt, hookSalt, tickLower, tickBand, tickUpper, startSqrtPriceX96, builderFeeRecipient))
launch.requiredLow14Bits: exactly beforeInitialize | beforeSwap | afterSwap | beforeSwapReturnDelta | afterSwapReturnDelta
launch.publicOrdering: an observer can sponsor the exact configuration; changing any launch parameter or hook salt changes the token prediction and cannot consume the intended configuration

pool.buyDirection: buying SHARD moves the tick down
pool.tickLower: constructor-supplied; must be a multiple of the tick spacing and below tickBand
pool.tickBand: constructor-supplied; lower edge of the concentrated band, between tickLower and tickUpper
pool.tickUpper: constructor-supplied; must be a multiple of the tick spacing
pool.startSqrtPriceX96: constructor-supplied; its tick must be at or above tickUpper, and beforeInitialize rejects any other start price

limits.partialFill: rejected with PartialFillNotSupported when ETH is the specified currency

fees.feeBasis: inclusive; the fee is part of the total ETH the trade moves, never added on top
chargedOn: third-party swaps, in beforeSwap or afterSwap depending on which side ETH is specified
buyNFT, buyMany, buyMax, sellNFT and sellMany, charged explicitly because v4 skips a hook's own callbacks
notChargedOn: redeem and redeemMany, whose shards already paid on the way out of the pool
donate, which is not swap volume
fees.rounding: builder and launcher cuts round down; remainder to holders

rewards.custody: held by the hook until claimed
rewards.holderClaims: settled per token id and paid to nft.ownerOf(id); escrowed while nothing is circulating and released to the first holder
rewards.holderAccrualDelay: one block; a piece earns from the block after acquisition
rewards.builderPayoutWalletChanges: builder-only, via setBuilderFeeRecipient; accrued fees follow the role
rewards.donations: donate() and ShardFeeForwarderV1 pay holders in full and are never split

positionLock.positionOwner: the hook itself; v4 keys positions on msg.sender, so no other contract can address them

roles.deployer: the launch factory; its one-shot setNFT and initialise powers are consumed atomically
roles.builderFeeRecipient: claims the builder share and may hand the role to a successor
roles.admin: none; no owner, no pause, no timelock, no upgrade path

transferChecks.erc20: all production transfer and transferFrom results used by the factory, hook, and router are checked and revert TokenTransferFailed on false
transferChecks.eth: refunds, payouts, and claims check call success and revert EthTransferFailed

artEntropy.security: non-secure randomness; inputs are public and miner-influenceable
